claims.normalizedStatement: The generation/control interaction between the native's Mệnh element and the Đại Vận palace element dictates environmental favorability.
The combined dignity (miếu/vượng/đắc/bình/hãm) of the principal stars in the Đại Vận palace governs the inherent strength of the decade.
A high concentration of supportive auxiliary stars (Tả Hữu, Khôi Việt, Xương Khúc) in the Đại Vận palace and its trines mitigates negative principal star dignity.
Hình/Hỏa meeting causes sudden calamity unless mitigated by Tuần/Triệt or specific saving stars.
Đại Vận Hóa Kỵ in the active palace severely disrupts the cycle's potential.
